description: Hardening: more Foundry fuzz tests; edge case coverage

VaultCore.note: Deposit/withdrawal requires Coston2 FAssets fork tests; safe-state/circuit-breaker/emergency paths fully covered
VaultCore.verdict: PASS (local paths >85%; full coverage in fork tests)

VaultCore: Circuit breaker reset and exit safe state
Emergency mode set/clear/trigger from solvency breach
Deposit blocked in safe state and emergency mode
Multi-verifier safe state and failure recording
Fuzz: circuit breaker consistency with arbitrary failure sequences
PolicyRegistry: Default policy strictness ordering (Conservative < Balanced < Aggressive)
Policy CRUD: create, set, update, status toggle
Non-owner access control for all mutating operations
Validate deposit/withdrawal at exact boundary values
Check action for all types (deposit, withdraw, rebalance, unknown)
Fuzz: deposit amount vs max validation
Fuzz: withdrawal amount vs max validation
SolvencyRoot: Zero root rejection, duplicate root rejection
Current proof invalidation on new publish
Merkle proof verification: single leaf, two leaf, three level tree
Proof invalidation: current, old, after verify
Min collateral ratio changes affecting solvency status
History edge cases: empty, single, partial, overflow
Fuzz: surplus variants, min collateral ratio, solvency ratio vs threshold
InstructionSender: All instruction types (PAYMENT, REBALANCE, REDEEM, EMERGENCY_TRANSFER)
Cancel from PENDING and SUBMITTED states
Fail from PENDING and SUBMITTED states
Terminal state protection (no transition from CANCELLED/FAILED/CONFIRMED)
Double operation protection (double cancel, double fail, double confirm)
Zero tx hash rejection on confirm
Fuzz: various amounts and position IDs
VerifierRole: Admin protection: single admin, multi-admin revocation
System_Invariants: Solvency status consistent with collateral ratio vs threshold
Confirmed instruction has non-zero tx hash and execution time
Default policies always exist with positive fields
Admin always has admin role, at least one admin exists
Full vault lifecycle integration (proof -> instruction -> confirm -> new proof)
Merkle proof integrity across publish/invalidate lifecycle
